verdict.rationale: Twenty documents the necessary building blocks — an MCP server (twenty-docs-32), GraphQL/REST APIs that can update any custom object including deal stage fields (twenty-docs-8, twenty-docs-22), workflows that can trigger on record/email changes and include an 'AI Agent' step (twenty-docs-13), and automatic email/calendar syncing to CRM records (twenty-docs-4, twenty-docs-52, twenty-docs-58) plus permissioned AI agents that can enrich records and execute multi-step tasks (twenty-docs-56, twenty-docs-71). However, there is no first-party example, tutorial, or case study showing an agent actually reading email/meeting signals and updating deal stage/next-steps fields end-to-end — this requires assembling multiple features rather than a documented turnkey capability. Missing for 10: a concrete documented workflow/tutorial showing stage/next-step updates driven by email or meeting signals, and independent/hands-on confirmation this works in practice.
